newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Gunmen block election team in Albania - agency.
newsitem.headline: Gunmen block election team in Albania - agency.

text.p: Gunmen blocked an election team travelling to the south of Albania on Thursday to provide advice for special elections being held next month and forced it to return to Tirana, the Albanian news agency ATA said.
The team of European specialists "was blocked by armed civilians at Memaliaj town", near Gjirokaster, and was forced to return to the capital, ATA said.
The mostly Italian mission was expected to return to Gjirokaster on Monday to hold meetings with representatives of political parties, the report added.

Officials of the Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE), which this week began sending technical experts around the country to provide technical advice for the June 29 elections, could not be reached for comment.

This Balkan country of 3.4 million has been in political turmoil since March when thousands of people lost their savings due to the collapse of shady pyramid schemes, sparking widespread rioting and looting of armouries.
The Western-brokered early elections are intended to restore confidence in the government and end continuing unrest and lawlessness in large parts of the country.
